verdict.rationale: A public template library is a fair question for a workflow engine like Windmill, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a public library of workflow or flow templates. The closest items cover the flow builder, workflows as code and auto-generated sharable UIs for scripts; none of these are a template catalog, and none can be credited here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
